description: This header file defines a dummy subclass of the Ambiorix class, called AmbiorixDummy, which provides stub implementations of various set and read_param methods, as well as methods to manage instances and time formats. It appears to be used for testing or simulation purposes within the prplMesh framework.

classes.name: AmbiorixDummy
classes.description: A dummy subclass of Ambiorix intended for testing, which overrides various set and get parameter methods, along with instance management and time-related functions.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overrides of 'set' method for various data types, setting parameters at a given relative path.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Overrides of 'read_param' to retrieve parameters of different types from specified object path.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance under a specified relative path.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance based on relative path and index.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a specific instance.

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Returns the time format used by the data model.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Removes all instances under a specified relative path.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Adds an optional subobject to a specified object.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Removes an optional subobject from a specified object.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Sets the current time for a specified object.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets the time at a specified object path.
